acceptance_criteria: All 11,146 source schedule rows across 2010-2022 are read only from their pinned capture manifests and payload hashes; schema variants are explicit and no duplicate normalized season/game key is accepted.
All 10,593 accepted historical outcomes join one-to-one by normalized source game ID and season; season/type identity is reconciled and unmatched or conflicting records fail closed.

Exactly 10,414 games with explicit venue ID and name evidence enter the development-only assignment payload; the 179 linked games without venue evidence remain explicit NOT_PRESENT quarantine rows rather than inferred values.

Every admitted source commit time precedes the earliest 2023 target cutoff, source seasons do not overlap 2023-2025 targets, and no outcome, label, target, post-cutoff, or current-catalog field enters the admitted payload.
Outputs preserve immutable content-addressed source, state, quarantine, manifest, validation, and field-missingness identities and pass an isolated byte-identical rebuild plus mutation controls.

Authority remains development-only historical venue evidence; protected training/evaluation, canonical timeless catalog promotion, production promotion, forecast publication, completeness, and scientific claims remain closed.
ai_context_notes: No OpenAI output or model-generated fact participates in acquisition, identity, timing, normalization, validation, or admission.
Venue fields are factual record-time evidence from pinned schedule rows, not a timeless canonical venue catalog.
The 2026 current venue candidate layer may be used only for non-PIT reconciliation diagnostics, never historical backfill.
definition_of_done: Every source and accepted-outcome row is deterministically dispositioned at season/game/domain/field grain, including the two numeric-ID schema variants and 179 NOT_PRESENT venue records.

An immutable external venue-assignment identity contains exact canonical game linkage, record-time venue evidence, source capture/hash/known-at lineage, explicit field missingness, and no inferred values.

Repository tests and independent external validation prove source hashes, join cardinality, chronology, target exclusion, schemas, counts, quarantines, authority, mutation failures, and byte-identical reconstruction.
Canonical and live Jira, Git/PR evidence, governing goal, active plan, cleanup, and scientific nonclaims agree before Done.
Historical acquisition and preliminary modeling continue independently without declaring final historical-population or production readiness.
end_to_end_validation: Re-read each pinned capture manifest and payload plus the accepted-outcome payload; independently rebuild normalized source keys, one-to-one canonical joins, admitted and NOT_PRESENT payloads, manifest, and hashes in an isolated external root; verify population, schema variants, missingness, chronology, target exclusion, authority, mutation controls, and byte identity; then remove reconstructible rebuild output.
in_scope: Thirteen immutable sportsdataverse/cfbfastR-data schedule captures for seasons 2010-2022 with public Git committer known-at times from 2023-05-04 through 2023-05-06.
Exact one-to-one source game ID and season linkage to the accepted historical-outcome dataset, including deterministic Float64-to-integer ID normalization for the 2011 and 2020 schema variants.
Game-grain venue ID, name, city, state, capacity, and indoor evidence exactly as recorded, with field-level missingness, content-addressed provenance, quarantine, and deterministic replay.
objective: Admit only exact game-ID-linked, version-bound 2010-2022 venue evidence into a development-only historical PIT state while preserving every absent venue, schema variant, and authority limitation.
out_of_scope: Name-only venue mapping, home-team stadium inference, current-catalog historical backfill, geocoding inference, or silently treating capacity and indoor attributes as timeless canonical truth.
Inventing missing venue assignments or attributes, discarding otherwise useful game/outcome seasons, or promoting unresolved venue aliases into canonical identity.
Protected training or evaluation, champion or production promotion, forecast publication, final historical completeness, A&M lift, BAS, Aggie Excess, or any scientific result.
prerequisites: Immutable accepted historical-outcome identity cf732b78db6deff2e2cca51364a18e03219a5ceda88d2f5efa475dad1f7e3fe7 with exact canonical game mappings.
Thirteen captured schedule payloads and capture manifests under the configured external data root.
Configured standardized external data root and protected W17 judging boundaries.
required_evidence: Exact source capture, payload, accepted-outcome, contract, code, dataset, quarantine, manifest, validation, Git, PR, and hosted-check identities.
Per-season source, linked, admitted, missing, schema, venue-field, game, byte, and hash counts plus ID/name ambiguity results.
Maximum source known-at time, minimum target cutoff, zero target overlap, zero outcome/target fields, mutation controls, and byte-identical rebuild.
Explicit record-time attribute, missing-evidence, current-catalog non-backfill, development-only authority, and protected/production/completeness/scientific nonclaims.

required_tests.expectation: Numeric-ID schema normalization, exact joins, NOT_PRESENT quarantine, chronology, target exclusion, and protected nonauthority remain deterministic.
The complete external population passes source identity, reconstruction, schema, provenance, mutation, and byte-identity checks.

risk_failure_conditions: Any source hash, normalized key, join cardinality, season/type identity, chronology, target overlap, schema, authority, population, or rebuild identity drifts.
Any name-only or home-team inference, current-catalog backfill, missing venue fabrication, outcome field, target field, or post-cutoff evidence enters the admitted payload.
Any record-time venue evidence is represented as timeless canonical truth or any development-only artifact is represented as protected, production, complete-history, or scientific authority.
scope: Normalize three observed schedule schema variants, join by normalized numeric source game ID and season to the immutable accepted-outcome identity, admit explicit record-time venue assignments, and quarantine missing venue evidence without fabricating a timeless venue catalog.
stop_conditions: Stop the affected row, field, season, or artifact on source, join, chronology, schema, authority, population, hash, or rebuild failure.
Quarantine only affected evidence and continue independent historical domains, acquisition, and preliminary modeling.
Do not weaken PIT, identity, missingness, or scientific boundaries merely to obtain admission.
title: [POST-SUBTASK-188] Admit version-bound historical venue assignments for development PIT
why_this_exists: The accepted 2010-2022 outcome population has exact source-game identities and 13 public repository schedule captures committed before every 2023-2025 target cutoff. Venue evidence can therefore advance independently without using the 2026 current catalog as a historical backfill or inferring venues from home teams.
